description: This file defines plugin configuration and utility functions for the kustomize project, including environment variable handling, directory path resolution, and plugin symbol constants.

classes.name: NotedFunc
classes.description: A struct representing a note and a function returning a string, used for path resolution logic.

methods.name: DefaultAbsPluginHome
methods.description: Returns the first existing directory path suitable as the plugin home directory, based on environment variables and default locations.

methods.name: FirstDirThatExistsElseError
methods.description: Checks multiple directory paths for existence and returns the first that exists or an error if none do.

methods.name: HomeDir
methods.description: Returns the user's home directory based on environment variables or defaults to '~'.

methods.name: homeEnv
methods.description: Determines the environment variable name for the user's home directory based on OS.

methods.name: CurrentWorkingDir
methods.description: Returns the current working directory, attempting to use environment variables or defaulting to the self directory.

methods.name: pwdEnv
methods.description: Determines the environment variable name for the current directory based on OS.
